rfqRoute: A UK buyer searching for custom printed boxes should not start with a price-only request.
The RFQ should define box type, internal size, product weight, quantity range, material direction, printing area, finish preference, insert need, artwork status and target sales channel.
Custom packaging boxes can include folding cartons, rigid boxes, mailer boxes or gift boxes, so the useful first step is to identify structure and product fit.
MUGE PACKAGING should route these searches to the quote checklist, then to the contact form with enough details for factory review.
After publishing, this segment should be watched through Ads search terms, GA4 key events and GSC query/page movement before bid or landing page changes.
